dialogues.speaker: Mtwa
dialogues.text: Poorly, I'm afraid. It seems the more I look into it, the more questions I have. Why is it that as soon as one leaves Natlan, the fragments seem to disappear?

dialogues.speaker: Mtwa
dialogues.text: On the road here, I asked many an outlander, but all they gave me were funny looks. None of them seemed to know what I was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Mtwa
dialogues.text: Then again, if I ran into a strange traveler from another land who was raving about a hole in the sky that I couldn't see, I'd probably think it was odd myself...

dialogues.speaker: Mtwa
dialogues.text: Well, not that I'm a traveler, obviously, I'm a researcher... That was just a hypothetical statement.
